### TAG-214: Isolate GHDL analysis libraries per example in `verify-examples`

**Status:** ⬜ Not started

## Software Notes

**Problem:** `verify_examples.zig` invokes `ghdl -a` without `--workdir`, so all examples share the default `work-obj08.cf` in CWD. Re-analyzing `matterscript_ncl.vhd` once per example bumps GHDL's order bookkeeping and "obsoletes" entities analyzed earlier, producing spurious failures across runs. Two examples declaring the same gate name (`AND`, `fanin`, …) collide even within one run, reopening cross-example leakage at the GHDL stage.

**Fix:** Allocate `.verify_scratch/ghdl_work/<tag>/` per example; thread `--workdir=` through every `ghdl -a` and `ghdl -e` call in both `runGhdlSyntaxCheck` and `runGhdlSimulation`. `.verify_scratch` is already wiped each run, so libraries are per-run and per-example.

**Acceptance:** Second consecutive `verify-examples` run yields identical results without a manual cache wipe; two examples with a shared entity name both pass in the same run.
